name: r0-adamod-dispatch-skinny-fp32-3xtf32
author: solx-loop
description: The op is an fp32 GEMM (M = batch, N = 18432, K = 3072) whose reference is FFMA-bound at 75% of the SIMT peak; tensor-core 3xTF32 (hi/lo split, three TF32 GEMMs, fp32 accumulate) is fp32-level accurate and 3x faster at M/L, while the small-B band is a 227 MB weight stream that a cp.async-staged skinny SIMT kernel serves at the copy floor. First, correctness-first anchor submission for Tb/Tsol.
